frozen_by: stage A2 of plan W10, written before any arm ran and before any of these documents was read past the passages quoted in sources.json
what_a_freeze_means_here: The three lists below are fixed for this round. Moving a document between them after a run is a new claim and is recorded as one, with the finding that forced it; it does not reach back and make an earlier count right.
the_rule_used_to_choose: The eight for the arms are every document in the corpus that has two named speakers or agents whose names the re-identification arm can exchange. Arm (x)'s count in plan W10 section 5 is 'at least four of eight documents', so the eight must all admit the edit or the count cannot be made as the frozen plan writes it.
That rule, and not domain spread, decided the eight. What it costs is written under what_this_gives_up.

The four in reserve are for the repeat under a new sorting (W3 section 8). They were chosen to carry the two domains the arms eight leave out (economics, instructions) and two kinds the arms are thin in (a single-voice argument about what cannot be shown, and a second animal fable).

The five outside the split are held out and not spent this round, as HV file 50's 33 held-out sources are not spent. They are not spares to be swapped in silently: using one is a change to the split and a new claim.

arms.why_here: an absence explained, and a poke anyone can name (turn the apparatus through ninety degrees)
why a problem cannot be solved, and an axiom that may be the answer hidden in the starting points
the plainest case in the corpus of the answer sitting in the starting points; two speakers throughout
a rival built inside the document, against the argument it attacks
a just-so story that says outright why elephants have trunks: swap and flip bite hardest here
two named design schools and a claim about which spreads and why
one document carrying a rule and its best rival, by two named judges: what counts as what, and a pair that pulls
the story offers its own rival explanation of the same events

reserve.why_here: why something cannot be shown at all, and the one document in the corpus on which look inside has real purchase
a second just-so story, so the repeat can be run on the same kind as W9 without reusing it
carries the instructions domain, which the arms eight leave out; gives remove a line and pull their best case
carries the economics domain, which the arms eight leave out; a claim about why a method fails

what_this_gives_up: Economics and instructions do not reach arms (a) to (f) and (r) this round. Nothing in the eight is a set of written instructions or an economic argument, so whatever those kinds would have shown about the arms is not shown here, and the coverage map says so.
Two of the eight are fiction and two are philosophy, so a difference between arms could be a difference between kinds of document. Three repeats per box on eight documents cannot tell those apart.
W7 is capped at 6,000 words and stops before the dialogue's close. A report that faults it for something settled in the last pages is the corpus's fault, not the reader's.
No two documents in the corpus are a claim and its published critique. What that costs is in coverage.md under the gaps.
